audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags this directly: 'level chart contradicts data: Kled wins only 47.99% but the chart gives Kled 4/7 stages vs 0'. Zaahen owned no stage anywhere on the page despite winning the matchup over 771 games.
audit.why: Kled's genuine window is levels 2-3, where W plus the Beartrap yank punish greedy trades before Zaahen's healing scales. Zaahen's kit is built the other way: The Darkin Glaive (Q) heals on its double slash, Grim Deliverance (R) heals for a portion of the damage it deals, and a full Determination bar lets him revive. Against Kled's frontloaded burst that is a late-game profile, so level 6 and two-plus items belong to him.
audit.corrected: Level 6 and 2+ items flipped to Zaahen; First item softened to Skill; Levels 2-3 stay Kled; Level 1 and 4-5 stay Skill. That gives Kled 2 stages, Zaahen 2, even 3 — consistent with a sub-50% win rate.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every spike was written as a Kled spike; nothing on the page identified a Zaahen power spike, and his ultimate was referred to only as 'Ultimate'.
audit.why: Zaahen spikes at 6 with Grim Deliverance (110/95/80s, heals off the damage dealt) and again once Determination fills and the revive is live.
audit.corrected: spikes[3] rewritten as his late window; R named with cooldown in the full layer.

audit.whatIsWrong: The whole page calls his ultimate 'Ultimate' and names no ability at all — 'His big cooldown. Q-pull around it.' is the entire interaction section.
audit.why: The Darkin Glaive (Q), 6-10s, is an auto-attack reset that slashes twice and heals, and its recast makes the next attack knock you up — so the attack wind-up is the tell, and the recast is the displacement. Dreaded Return (W), 12-14s, stabs and pulls you in from 850 units, which is the range that beats your 800-unit Beartrap. Aureate Rush (E), 8-10s, is a dash whose damage scales with health, so stacking Skaarl's health does not answer it. Grim Deliverance (R), 80-110s, heals him for a portion of the damage dealt.
audit.corrected: All four named with cooldowns in the cooldown and interaction fields.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal anywhere in the item line, against a champion with healing on both Q and R.
audit.why: Grievous Wounds applied before the extended trade is what stops Q's per-slash heal and R's damage-based heal from refunding your combo. Armour alone is also the wrong buy, since Aureate Rush scales with health.

notes: The packet's own defect line is the headline here: the chart gave Kled 4 of 7 stages and Zaahen none, in a lane Kled loses at 47.99% over 771 games. Rebalanced to Kled 2 / Zaahen 2 / even 3, with level 6 and two-plus items given to him on the strength of his kit (healing on Q and R plus the Determination revive) rather than on any external source. Ability names came from the missing-interactions record, since packet.enemyAbilities was null for this champion. Confidence on the exact stage boundaries is Medium — the win rate and kit support a Zaahen late, but there is no per-stage data in the packet to pin whether First item is even or already his.
